{{Quote|Here at Zephyr Base wesa plannin' strategies for fightin' de Empire on Naboo. My bein' liyayzonn to all Gungans on Naboo, gettin' dere hep.|Booto Lubble, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Booto Lubble''' was a [[Sexes/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Stationed at [[Zephyr Base]] on [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], he served as a liaison between the Gungans of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In addition to his Rebel duties, Lubble became preoccupied with impressing the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Teacher/Legends|trainer]] [[Raxa Binn]], whom he attempted to court with a gift in the form of a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] fashioned from captured [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] equipment.

==Biography==
===Service to the Alliance===
{{Quote|Yousa be talkin' to mesa back here when yousa not bein' so busy, hey?|Booto Lubble, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Booto Lubble was a [[Sexes/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who served as a liaison between his people on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" /> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he was stationed at the Rebel Outpost on Naboo's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], also known as [[Zephyr Base]]. In the outpost, Lubble could be found inside a small building that served as Zephyr Base’s combat guild hall. The structure contained two rooms including one outfitted with [[Sleeper (furniture)|beds]] and another acting as an [[Armory/Legends|armory]] stocked with a supply of [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]. There, Lubble provided intelligence and support to Alliance operatives while also involving himself in more personal pursuits. Though committed to the Rebel cause, he harbored a strong fondness for<ref name="AED" /> the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]<ref name="Binn">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Raxa Binn|Rori}}</ref> [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Teacher/Legends|trainer]] [[Raxa Binn]], and several of his assignments revolved around efforts to impress her.<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
===The Rank Cylinder===
{{Quote|Why does the rank cylinder have to be from this warrant officer?"<br />"Ooah, de rank cylinder tings for warrant officers bein' just de right color for matchin' Raxa Binn's eyes!|A spacer and Booto Lubble|<ref name="AED" />}}
Hoping to craft a [[Necklace/Legends|necklace]] as a gift for Binn, Lubble enlisted the aid of a Rebel-aligned [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]. He explained that the necklace would require the [[Code cylinder/Legends|rank cylinder]] of a [[Warrant Officer/Legends|warrant officer]], whose devices, he believed, carried a [[Color/Legends|hue]] that matched Binn’s [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. To this end, he directed the spacer to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Warrant Officer [[Luhin Jinnor]], an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] in [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Zarvold|Zarvold's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]]. Jinnor patrolled the wilderness near Zephyr Base under the guard of two [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]]. The operative defeated the escort, killed Jinnor, and retrieved the cylinder.<ref name="AED" />

Lubble expressed delight when the spacer returned, declaring it the “just-right ting mesa needin’ on de necklace for Raxa.” In gratitude, he rewarded the operative with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and hinted that further tasks would follow.<ref name="AED" />

===The Thermal Detonator===
{{Quote|Why do you want a thermal detonator for a necklace pendant?"<br />"Ooh, one time mesa overhearin' Raxa Binn, shesa sayin, 'Evvy tim I seein' dat Gungan, I want a termal detanator.'|Booto Lubble, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
After securing the rank cylinder, Lubble sought another contribution to his necklace. This [[Time/Legends|time]], he requested a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] to serve as its pendant. He explained that he had once overheard Binn quip that every time she saw him, she wanted a thermal detonator, and in his earnest if misguided reasoning, he believed presenting her with one would please her. Lubble also remarked that she despised Colonel Zarvold, though he did not know why, and thought the weapon would carry sentimental value for her.<ref name="AED" />

Lubble identified the target as [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rohd Gostervek]], another of Zarvold’s [[Officer/Legends|officers]], who patrolled the Rori wilderness with four Imperial Army troopers. The spacer confronted the patrol, killed the captain and his guards, and recovered the [[Grenade/Legends|explosive device]],<ref name="AED" /> a [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] [[Class-A thermal detonator/Legends|Class-A explosive]].<ref name="Detonator">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Imperial Army Thermal Detonator}}</ref>

Lubble was overjoyed at the spacer’s return. Declaring the detonator the perfect centerpiece for his gift, he combined it with the cylinder to complete the necklace. Convinced that the unusual creation would soften Binn’s [[Heart/Legends|heart]], he thanked the spacer profusely and rewarded them with additional credits.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}
==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|My be sweetin' on de commando trainer here, Raxa Binn. Shesa mooie-mooie! My tinkin' shesa likin' a necklace made of Empire rank cylinder tings.|Booto Lubble, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
Booto Lubble was an orange-skinned Gungan male with orange eyes who served the Rebel Alliance as a liaison at Zephyr Base on Rori. He spoke in the distinctive [[Gungan (language)|Gungan dialect]], often using phrases such as “mesa,” “yousa,” and “mooie bombad” in his conversations with spacers.<ref name="AED" />

In addition to his official duties coordinating with fellow Gungans on Naboo, Lubble displayed a more personal side when dealing with operatives. He openly expressed admiration for<ref name="AED" /> the Zabrak<ref name="Binn" /> commando trainer Raxa Binn, describing her as “mooie-mooie” and attempting to craft a necklace from captured Imperial equipment to impress her. His requests for a warrant officer’s rank cylinder and later a thermal detonator reflected his earnest but naïve attempts at courtship, as he believed such items would please her.<ref name="AED" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Yousa gettin' dat rank cylinder ting yet? My workin' on Raxa's necklace berry hard.|Booto Lubble, to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
During his time at Zephyr Base, Booto Lubble wore a [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] similar in appearance to those of the [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagung]],<ref name="AED" /> [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name="SW-Visual">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> He also possessed Rebel weapons.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Owoo! No termal detanator? Mooie bombad! Raxa Binn, shesa nevah likin' mesa now!|Booto Lubble, to players who failed to retrieve the thermal detonator|<ref name="AED" />}}
Booto Lubble was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Lubble offered two quests at Zephyr Base on Rori, both of which were available only to Rebel-aligned players. Each quest followed a fetch-style format centered on his attempt to craft a necklace for the commando trainer Raxa Binn. The first tasked players with retrieving the rank cylinder of Warrant Officer Luhin Jinnor, an Imperial operating under Colonel Zarvold. Jinnor was accompanied by two Imperial troopers, and killing Jinnor allowed the player to recover<ref name="AED" /> "Officer Jinnor's Rank Cylinder."<ref name="Cylinder">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Officer Jinnor's Rank Cylinder}}</ref> Successful completion of the quest granted a reward of 50 credits and 100 Rebel faction points.<ref name="AED" />

The second quest required the recovery of an<ref name="AED" /> "Imperial Army Thermal Detonator"<ref name="Detonator" /> carried by Captain Rohd Gostervek, another officer under Zarvold. Gostervek patrolled with a larger escort of four Imperial troopers. Upon eliminating the captain, players could return the detonator to Lubble. This quest also rewarded 50 credits and 100 Rebel faction points.<ref name="AED" />
